sources.video_title: The Free 975B AI Model You Can Own (Inkling AI)
sources.description:
Inkling AI is Mira Murati's free 975B open-weights model on Hugging Face, but running it yourself has a catch

Inkling is the new 975-billion-parameter open-weights model from Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab, and it's the first credible American entry in an open-weights tier that's been dominated by Chinese labs. This breaks down what's actually inside the release: a mixture-of-experts architecture with 41 billion active parameters per token, a 1M-token context window, 45 trillion tokens of multimodal pretraining, and a controllable thinking-effort dial that trades compute for accuracy. Inkling debuted at 41 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, edging out Nemotron 3 Ultra, though Thinking Machines itself admits it's not the strongest model available, open or closed, and hands-on testers report it trailing GLM 5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on some benchmarks.

The real story is what open weights actually buy you. Apache 2.0 licensing, day-zero support in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and Unsloth, and a companion fine-tuning platform called Tinker mean you can inspect, audit, and specialize the model instead of renting a closed API. But the hardware reality is brutal, hundreds of gigabytes of RAM even quantized, terabytes of VRAM for the full checkpoint, so most people end up renting it anyway through Together AI, OpenRouter, or Tinker, at output pricing roughly four times comparable open models.

This is for builders and AI-curious viewers trying to figure out whether an open, ownable base model actually beats renting a frontier chatbot, and who Inkling is realistically built for.

sources.video_title: Nanobot - Build Your Own Self-Hosted AI Agent (Complete Tutorial 2026)
sources.description:
👍 Like | 💬 Comment | 🔔 Subscribe | ⭐ Star on GitHub

Nanobot is an ultra-lightweight, open-source personal AI agent framework written in Python. In this complete tutorial, I'll show you how to install, configure, and master Nanobot — from the WebUI to terminal chat, multi-channel integration, MCP tools, persistent memory with Dream, multi-agent delegation, and deployment.

What's Covered:

0:00 — Introduction
0:48 — The Problem with AI Agents
1:31 — What is Nanobot?
2:37 — Core Features
4:56 — Installation
6:13 — Quick Start
7:31 — Architecture Deep Dive
8:49 — Configuration & Customization
10:06 — Advanced: Subagents, Memory & Automations
11:07 — Deployment
11:39 — Community & Use Cases
12:40 — Summary & Call to Action

Key Features:
🐍 Pure Python — lightweight, readable core (~3K LOC)
🖥️ WebUI + Terminal + 10+ chat platforms
🧰 15+ built-in tools (files, shell, web, MCP, cron, image gen)
🧠 Long-term memory via Dream consolidation
👥 Multi-agent delegation with inline subagents
🎯 Model freedom — any OpenAI-compatible provider
🔓 MIT License — fully open source

Install in one command:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HKUDS/nanobot/main/scripts/install.sh | sh

Resources:
🔗 GitHub: https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot
📖 Docs: https://nanobot.wiki
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/MnCvHqpUGB
🐦 X: https://x.com/nanobot_project

stories.title: Nanobot Framework Lowers Deployment Friction with Modular Python Toolchains
stories.summary: Open-source agent infrastructure simplifies complex orchestration by bundling memory consolidation, multi-channel routing, and MCP support into a lightweight core. The framework enables direct installation via standard package managers while maintaining full visibility into request pipelines and state transitions.

stories.title: Google Cloud Integrates Gemini Enterprise Endpoints into Unified Agent Routing Systems
stories.summary: Infrastructure updates combine proprietary language and vision endpoints to allow developers to switch models dynamically during complex task execution. The unified platform supports automated testing layers and draft submission workflows that adapt to varying latency requirements.

stories.title: Tinker Interface Enables Direct Fine-Tuning of Open Architectures for Specialized Deployments
stories.summary: New companion platforms lower the barrier to adapting base models by automating data preparation and hyperparameter selection. This approach shifts focus from renting closed APIs to constructing dedicated agents optimized for narrow corporate domains.

stories.title: Autonomous Cyber Agents Now Anchor Majority of Advanced Persistent Threat Vectors in Annual Reports
stories.summary: Security analysis confirms that coordinated AI programs execute exploitation chains faster than traditional defense layers can patch vulnerabilities. Organizations must implement coalition frameworks to map institutional knowledge gaps against synthetic adversarial capability sets.

stories.title: Code Execution Platforms Refine Planning Workflows by Routing Subtasks to Dedicated Nodes
stories.summary: Development environments now isolate complex planning stages into independent computational children to maintain primary session stability. This delegation pattern reduces memory pressure on core models and improves error recovery across multi-step coding pipelines.

stories.title: Kimi K3 Technical Report Details Efficiency Gains in Next Generation Reasoning Paths
stories.summary: New structural approaches prioritize compressed token retention and iterative validation loops to reduce computational spend on long tasks. The paper outlines how targeted pretraining phases yield measurable improvements in multi-step problem solving without expanding parameter counts.

stories.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Establishes New Throughput Baselines While Competing on Intelligence Metrics
stories.summary: Architectural refinements in this iteration balance aggressive optimization targets with sustained capability scoring across standard benchmarks. The model maintains strong alignment with regional competitors while prioritizing consistent output velocity for mass-scale requests.

stories.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro Disrupts Budget Inference Tiers with Extreme Cost Compression Without Sacrificing Accuracy
stories.summary: The model achieves peak scoring on mathematical and coding tasks while driving operational expenses down to record lows. This pricing strategy forces established providers to reevaluate tier structures and exposes the widening capability gap between base variants and specialized reasoning models.

stories.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash Targets Latency Sensitive Deployments by Optimizing Sparse Routing for Real-Time Responses
stories.summary: Engineering teams prioritize rapid response generation by activating only relevant network subsets during token prediction phases. This approach delivers measurable latency improvements while maintaining sufficient accuracy scores for time-critical commercial applications.

stories.title: Qwen3.7 Max Pushes Standard Context Lengths Higher While Maintaining Competitive Pricing for Asian Enterprise Markets
stories.summary: Scaling initiatives focus on dense pretraining cycles that support extended document analysis without exponential compute penalties. The architecture competes directly with Western flagship offerings by offering expansive context retention paired with aggressive commercial licensing terms.

stories.title: Inference Engines Prioritize KV Cache Throughput for Long-Horizon Retrieval
stories.summary: Deployment frameworks are shifting focus toward managing massive context windows common in vector search pipelines. Day-zero support for new open-weight architectures enables faster serialization and reduces batching bottlenecks during dense embedding lookups.

stories.title: Local Agent Framework Compresses Tool Output into Persistent Memory Streams
stories.summary: A new Python-based architecture introduces Dream consolidation to streamline internal knowledge storage. The system automatically filters redundant retrieval artifacts, preserving only high-fidelity context segments for downstream reasoning steps.

stories.title: Google Platform Abstracts Vector Store Integration into Standardized Agent Workflows
stories.summary: Enterprise deployments are moving toward unified retrieval pipelines that automatically route queries across internal indexes and external APIs. The updated agent stack standardizes reranking and chunking parameters, reducing custom middleware requirements for corporate search applications.

stories.title: Production Routing Protocols Adopt Millisecond Response Latency as Primary Vector
stories.summary: Infrastructure teams are prioritizing time-to-first-token metrics when orchestrating multi-hop retrieval chains. New index data confirms that models optimized for low-latency first-chunk delivery outperform broader intelligence scores in live retrieval loops requiring immediate grounding.

stories.title: Distributed Inference Aggregators Reduce Custom Checkpoint Experimentation Costs
stories.summary: Specialized retrieval models and domain-specific embedding checkpoints are experiencing accelerated adoption through shared compute networks. Marketplaces now route traffic to optimized endpoints per query type, enabling rapid reranker testing without fixed GPU provisioning.

stories.title: Kimi K3 Reveals Multimodal Pretraining Pipeline for Visual Reasoning
stories.summary: The Hugging Face research team reviews the Kimi K3 technical report, detailing its multimodal pretraining pipeline and vision encoder integration. The model aims to bridge text and visual reasoning for more accurate image understanding tasks without heavy post-processing.

stories.title: Claude Opus 5 Expands Beyond Text with Native Image-to-3D Features
stories.summary: Anthropic's latest frontier model introduces native image-to-3D conversion alongside video generation capabilities, shifting focus from pure text processing to spatial asset creation. This expansion allows developers to generate textured 3D assets directly from single photographs, accelerating digital prototyping workflows.

stories.title: Inkling AI Releases 975B Parameter Open-Weights Model with Vast Visual Training Data
stories.summary: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab releases the 975B parameter open-weights model, featuring a 45 trillion token multimodal pretraining dataset that explicitly targets image and video representation. The release prioritizes direct fine-tuning via the Tinker platform, enabling teams to customize generative pipelines for specialized commercial use cases.

stories.title: Nanobot Framework Integrates Autonomous Image Generation Tools for Local Agents
stories.summary: The Nanobot project integrates fifteen built-in utilities for personal AI automation, including dedicated text-to-image and visual manipulation routines within its Python core. By unifying these generative APIs alongside MCP toolchains, the framework lowers the barrier for agents to produce and process digital media autonomously.

stories.title: Open-Access Platform Shifts Focus Toward Developer-Customizable Multimodal Weights
stories.summary: The Hugging Face hosting infrastructure now supports direct deployment for large-scale open models, allowing engineers to bypass closed APIs and run customized vision models locally. This architectural shift prioritizes developer control over generative outputs and lowers inference costs for specialized image synthesis tasks.

stories.title: Kimi K3 Unveils Multimodal Pretraining Pipeline for Visual Reasoning
stories.summary: Research details how the architecture optimizes spatial tasks through integrated multimodal pretraining steps. The model explicitly handles image to concept mapping establishing a new technical baseline for generative visual analysis.

stories.title: Hugging Face Journal Club Dissects Kimi K3 Spatial Capabilities
stories.summary: The research team breaks down the model handling of geometric and artistic constraints during live analysis. Findings highlight practical adjustments needed for integrating heavy parameter systems into existing creative toolsets.

stories.title: Nanobot Framework Lowers Deployment Friction with Modular Python Toolchains
stories.summary: An open source agent system built for automated task delegation now supports streamlined integrations for design workflows. Its licensed architecture allows creators to orchestrate custom asset assistants without external dependencies.

stories.title: Google Cloud Pivots Enterprise Agents Toward Verification Layers
stories.summary: The new Platform emphasizes draft pull requests and automated inspection instead of direct content generation. Teams managing design pipelines are adopting verification hooks to maintain strict quality standards before asset deployment.

stories.title: Thinking Machines Lab Releases Tinker for Creative Model Specialization
stories.summary: The new platform provides direct access to the Inkling architecture bypassing closed API restrictions. Designers and artists can now fine tune generative weights locally to match exact stylistic requirements without hardware rental costs.

stories.title: Lava Devanagari, Kannada, and Telugu Namrata Goyal
stories.summary: A new multilingual release expands support for South Asian scripts with precise script specific rules. The typeface implements correct conjunct formation and vertical baseline adjustments for accurate rendering.

stories.title: Now Open: the Typographica Library
stories.summary: A digital archive now hosts scanned type specimens and correspondence from mid century designers. Researchers can access high resolution plates and original kerning tables for historical analysis.

stories.title: Freight Sans Pro by The Freight Collection :
stories.summary: The Freight team expands its commercial release with an enhanced sans serif family. Updated optical sizes and refined glyph coverage make it suitable for dense data visualization and editorial grids.

stories.title: Tomasa Álvaro Franca
stories.summary: Recent work highlights a contemporary designer known for experimental organic letterforms. The typeface family introduces irregular stroke widths meant to mimic hand carved wood relief.

stories.title: Ground Robots Inherit the Kill Zone
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense startups are rapidly fielding autonomous ground vehicles to handle frontline reconnaissance and supply runs, reducing infantry exposure in contested corridors. Systems from RoverTech and DevDroid integrate real-time navigation with lightweight armament suites, adapting commercial autonomy stacks for high-threat environments. The acceleration points toward standardized robotic logistics replacing manual convoy routes within the current conflict window.

stories.title: Building a Foundation Stack for General-Purpose Robots
stories.summary: Chinese startup X Square Robot unveiled Wall-OSS-0.5, an open foundation stack designed to unify sensor fusion, predictive world modeling, and motor control for humanoid platforms. The architecture treats discrete interactions rather than static trajectories as the primary training unit, aiming to bootstrap general-purpose manipulation capabilities. Early weights target rapid downstream fine-tuning across diverse domestic tasks.

stories.title: Video Friday: A World Cup for Robots
stories.summary: For the first time, two fully sized humanoid squads competed in an eleven versus eleven soccer match on physical hardware, marking a milestone for coordinated locomotion and tactical AI. The event featured rapid gait adaptations from Agility Robotics, Figure AI, and Generalist while advancing competitive benchmarks for dynamic balance. Engineering teams now pivot toward scaling chassis durability over simulated perfection.

stories.title: Wristband enables wearers to control a robotic hand with their own movements
stories.summary: MIT engineers created an ultrasound wristband that scans muscle and tendon dynamics in real time to map finger positions without optical tracking. A live AI algorithm converts sonar signals into precise prosthetic commands, enabling wireless manipulation of robotic hands or virtual interfaces. The system captures nuanced gestures for future humanoid dexterity training sets.

stories.title: Experts react to FCC limits on U.S. imports of new humanoid and mobile robots
stories.summary: Federal communications regulators introduced new import controls targeting specific humanoid and mobile robot platforms amid escalating hardware security assessments. Industry leaders warn that blanket restrictions could stall domestic deployment pipelines while encouraging parallel supply chains for restricted components. Policy advocates are now pushing for targeted risk tiers rather than broad procurement freezes.

stories.title: Shieldstral
stories.summary: The framework introduces a modular alignment layer that filters unsafe outputs during multimodal generation separately from base models, enabling compliance without retraining.

stories.title: Penelope: Localized Latent Recurrence for Efficient Structured Reasoning
stories.summary: The paper proposes a dynamic memory routing mechanism that activates localized latent states only when specific reasoning chains require persistent storage, reducing activation overhead while maintaining long-horizon consistency.

stories.title: Parallel Decoding Distillation for Fast Image and Video Generation
stories.summary: The technique trains student models to predict multiple output tokens simultaneously, cutting inference latency nearly in half while preserving fine texture details on consumer GPUs.

stories.title: TIGA: Trajectory Injected Generative Attack against Black box AIGC Detectors
stories.summary: The study uses diffusion path manipulation to bypass detector classifiers, highlighting critical vulnerabilities in current digital provenance watermarking standards.

stories.title: AngelSpec: Towards Real-World High Performance Inference with Speculative Decoding
stories.summary: The framework introduces speculative decoding techniques to optimize inference speed on enterprise hardware, demonstrating up to three times faster token generation while maintaining output quality above 98 percent accuracy.

stories.title: On the Use of Synthetic Data for Threshold Calibration in Face Recognition: Performance and Security Implications for Border Control Systems
stories.summary: The research tests how synthetic facial datasets shift model decision boundaries in government screening pipelines, documenting accuracy degradation and adversarial evasion rates during threshold calibration.
